newsitem.title: USA: HealthSouth, Horizon/CMS may merge - NYT.
newsitem.headline: HealthSouth, Horizon/CMS may merge - NYT.

text.p: HealthSouth is negotiating to buy Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp for about $1 billion in stock, the New York Times said on Tuesday.
People familiar with the talks told the paper that HealthSouth's board approved the purchase on Monday, but added that the deal might not go through.
The report said the proposed pact would give Horizon shareholders 0.42169 share of HealthSouth common stock for each Horizon share.
HealthSouth would assume $700 million in Horizon debt in the deal, the paper said.

The combined entity would have a fourth of the nation's outpatient rehabilitation centers and almost two-thirds of the 190 rehabilitation hospitals. The report said analysts do not expect antitrust regulators to find problems with the merger.
HealthSouth closed up 3/8 at 43-1/8 Friday, and Horizon closed up 1/8 at 14-1/4. Stock markets were closed Monday for George Washington's Birthday.
